job.title: Delivery Executive SAP CX (human)
job.email_subject: Application: Delivery Executive SAP CX – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Delivery Executive SAP CX role needs someone who keeps SAP Commerce delivery on track across business and IT – my daily work for 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Stakeholder management, requirements and functional specifications
– CCv2 deployment cycles, releases and production support
– SAP ERP / MDM / PIM integrations with international teams

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Delivery Lead SAP CX | SAP Commerce Cloud, Stakeholder Management & Integrations
tailoring.summary: SAP CX professional with 5+ years delivering on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Brings techno-functional delivery strength: stakeholder management, requirements engineering, user stories, functional specifications, UAT and agile delivery with PI Planning, plus technical depth in CCv2 deployment cycles, production support and PIM / ERP / MDM integration. Coordinates with international technical teams, guides junior developers and uses AI tools to accelerate analysis and documentation. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: All for One is one of the leading SAP partners for the German Mittelstand, and SAP CX delivery there means real business impact for customers. I want to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud delivery and stakeholder experience to a partner whose core is SAP, with a team that values reliable delivery. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, the Delivery Executive SAP CX role caught my eye: 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud delivery (Rockwell Automation, Shell), stakeholder management, CCv2 releases, SAP certified. Karlsruhe, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Delivery Executive SAP CX
en.hook: Delivering SAP CX projects successfully means keeping customers, business teams and developers aligned while the platform stays stable. That is the environment I have worked in for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I deliver SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) solutions between business and IT – certified as SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: SAP CX delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows and supported production issues to keep platforms stable.

bullets.label: Stakeholder management
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders: analysed requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Complex integrations
bullets.text: Resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee working directly with international technical teams; built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines.

bullets.label: Team guidance & quality
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, provided technical guidance to junior developers and supported UAT with product owners and business teams.

en.logistics: All for One's SAP focus and customer base in the Mittelstand fit the delivery experience I bring. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would welcome a conversation about how I can strengthen your SAP CX delivery.
